components.name: Memory Button
components.description: The current-video action, neutral at rest and white when engaged.
components.css: .ds-memory-button { min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 13px; color: #f5f5f5; background: #292929; border: 1px solid #666666; border-radius: 5px; font: 650 14px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 140ms ease-out, background-color 140ms ease-out, border-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-memory-button:hover { color: #090909; background: #f5f5f5; border-color: #ffffff; } .ds-memory-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.css: .ds-danger-button { min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 13px; color: #090909; background: #f5f5f5; border: 1px solid #f5f5f5; border-radius: 5px; font: 650 14px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-danger-button:hover { background: #ffffff; } .ds-danger-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Resume Toggle
components.description: A native checkbox beneath the compact memory-track treatment.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch-input { position: absolute; z-index: 1; width: 44px; height: 28px; margin: 0; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch-track { position: relative; display: block; width: 44px; height: 26px; background: #090909; border: 1px solid #666666; border-radius: 13px; } .ds-switch-track::after { position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 4px; width: 16px; height: 16px; content: ''; background: #bdbdbd; border-radius: 50%; transition: left 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-switch-input:checked + .ds-switch-track { background: color-mix(in srgb, #f5f5f5 32%, #090909); border-color: #f5f5f5; } .ds-switch-input:checked + .ds-switch-track::after { left: 22px; background: #ffffff; } .ds-switch-input:focus-visible + .ds-switch-track { outline: 2px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: A native select with a machined control boundary.
components.html: <label class="ds-select-label" for="ds-retention">Keep unfinished positions</label><select class="ds-select" id="ds-retention"><option>90 days</option><option>Never expire</option></select>
components.css: .ds-select-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: #f5f5f5; font: 670 14px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-select { min-width: 158px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 34px 8px 11px; color: #f5f5f5; background: #292929; border: 1px solid #666666; border-radius: 5px; font: 14px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
YT Resume borrows the useful grammar of a dedicated video deck: one unmistakable time counter, a small illuminated memory state, compact transport controls, and labels that say exactly what they do. It feels like dependable hardware living in the browser—not a miniature dashboard and not nostalgic decoration.

The world is restrained, monochrome, and precise. Matte black surfaces frame inset display windows; tabular time is the visual anchor; a single white status light makes saved state visible. Motion is limited to state changes that communicate recording, restoration, or deletion.
keyCharacteristics: A large tabular timecode is the primary status signal.
Matte black planes and inset displays create hierarchy without card grids.
One white signal light marks active or saved state.
Compact literal labels keep controls understandable at toolbar scale.
Decorative video nostalgia is excluded; every deck reference must serve a task.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Bright white denotes memory or immediate attention. If several unrelated elements compete at once, the system has lost its hierarchy.

rules.name: The Counter Owns the Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospaced type belongs to time and compact status values; prose and actions use the native UI face.

rules.name: The Chassis Rule
rules.body: Every surface is either chassis, inset display, or control; avoid stacking generic containers merely to group content.

dos: **Do** make saved time and extension state legible in a glance.
**Do** use tabular numerals for every duration and timestamp.
**Do** give keyboard focus a high-contrast white treatment and preserve system colors in forced-colors mode.
**Do** preserve familiar checkbox, select, and button behavior beneath the visual language.
donts: **Don't** turn every row into a rounded card.
**Don't** use glowing neon, scanlines, tape noise, or faux-VHS distortion.
**Don't** use YouTube red as a general-purpose brand shortcut.
**Don't** animate the timecode continuously when a static value communicates the state.
